facts.title: Kaiser–Kiyora
facts.text: Kiyora uses Borderline on Kaiser. Once the pass connects, Kaiser Volley changes to Kaiser Magnus; activate it to trigger chemistry.

history.title: Don Lorenzo revamp
history.text: New kit and goalkeeper-box awakening variant. A Ubers interaction rewards three or four distinct listed styles in the opponent half; new and revised jerseys were announced.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Sae revamp
history.text: New base and awakening abilities and an aerial awakening variant. Ness–Kaiser reworked chemistry reported live.

history.title: Ness rework
history.text: Revised kit and animations. Ness–Kaiser chemistry described as upcoming; later announced live on August 15.

history.title: Kaiser–Kiyora chemistry
history.text: New Isagi Final Shot cutscene and My Finest Clown MVP. Borderline to Kaiser can trigger the Kaiser Magnus chemistry after the pass connects.

history.title: Dragon Drive and overtime awakening
history.text: Added aerial C-key Dragon Drive to NEL Shidou and custom awakening bars. Overtime grants awakening to one random player on each team.

history.title: Awakening and performance fixes
history.text: Awakening bars draining during cutscenes fixed across many styles; major crash and lag fixes announced for new servers.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: Otoya and game fixes
history.text: Dynamo Pass range +20%; Sneaky Volley speed and distance −20%; Kablamo gained i-frames. Similar ball-ring colors prevented on opposing teams.

history.title: Kaiser release
history.text: Kaiser update introduced the Emperor-inspired style.
